newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices lower at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices lower at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices were on average lower at the weekly export auction in Nairobi, auction officials said on Tuesday.
"Coffee was lower because of quality. Most of what was on offer was the new (fly) crop," a trader said.
Grade ABs averaged $265 per 50-kg from $317 last week while grade AAs averaged $282 from $326.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 20,275 60-kg bags of coffee compared to 20,843 bags sold last week.
